geometry.format: WCS6 lossless byte shuffle + contour deltas
geometry.native_transform: Native pixel index = field_origin + integer contour pixel index × 0.425 / native_mpp; all contour components and holes retained.
geometry.contours: Boundary-pixel centre lines from complete raster rings; areas computed from original masks, not contour polygons.
geometry.atlas: Discrete display of real native masks at0.85um and coarser. Native contours and raster-derived measurements remain authoritative.

provenance.original_points: Historical CellSTP v7.1 step27500 files preserved unchanged; no longer the default
provenance.source_images: Original TCGA SVS; existing web H&E is a lossy preview
provenance.candidate_source: Prior CellSTP 25µm masks; candidates retained even where v15 disagrees
provenance.stage_source: Released Cho et al. Science checkpoints, strict cascade; first head retains four native outputs. Different upstream candidate detector.
provenance.default_points: NuClass v15 step59712; all original analysis-valid nuclei

limits: Two previously displayed TCGA LUAD slides; no matched molecular or pathologist TLS gold.
Composition types are descriptive; E/P/S predictions do not confirm biological maturity.
No patient prognosis, validated clinical composite or superior segmentation accuracy is claimed.

Whole-slide geometry and v15 classification are complete. Candidate-specific metrics, surrogate fidelity and image interventions retain their original frozen analysis scope; all prior v15 posterior rows are unchanged.

policy.scope: Unvalidated image-constrained boundary refinement, not pathologist TLS segmentation. No shape or circularity target.

tls_boundary_refinement.primary_metrics: Original25µm candidates; refinement is a separately displayed, unvalidated boundary variant.

analysis_summary.scope: Complete S03/S07 whole-slide geometry; original candidate analyses remain frozen separately

geometry_delivery.cache: Bounded native contours, 64 MiB display atlas, 8 MiB compressed bundles; visible fields only

rendering.overview: Discrete multiresolution display of complete masks; zoom in for original integer contours.
rendering.width: GPU screen-mask compositing, configurable CSS pixels
rendering.fill: Independent whole-cell/nuclear polygon fills with holes

tissue_gate.policy: Display admission only. Pinned VitaminP _calculate_tissue_percentage on unnormalised512px RGB, threshold0.1, OR every original valid-nucleus core, then one-core3x3 dilation. Raw masks and measurements are retained; a viewer toggle exposes background-rejected predictions.
tissue_gate.brightfield_rule: RGB→gray;7x7Gaussian blur; dark pixels≤210. Original method selects modality by mean gray>100.

original_explanation_summary.scope: All189 prior candidate regions plus fixed controls and saved fields; not full-slide whole-cell coverage

coverage_policy: Complete native whole-slide384px core lattice at0.425um; all backgrounds also processed. Display uses derived multiresolution masks and native contours.
